mapper.insert: INSERT INTO secondhand_subscription (user_id, keyword, category, max_price, campus, status, create_time, update_time, last_notified_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{keyword}, #{category}, #{maxPrice}, #{campus}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{lastNotifiedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, keyword, category, max_price, campus, status, create_time, update_time, last_notified_at FROM secondhand_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM secondhand_subscription WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE secondhand_subscription SET last_notified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
